brief:
The Central Elections Commission announced Saturday the start of the nomination stage for the 2026 legislative elections, Palestine News Network reported. The submission period for electoral lists will run concurrently across the West Bank and Gaza Strip, according to the commission's statement made in Al-Bireh.

The announcement marks the formal opening of candidate registration for parliamentary elections scheduled two years ahead. Further details regarding nomination deadlines and participation requirements were not immediately available.
